en: Vintage multi-view postcard showing the Romanian seaside resort Eforie Nord on the Black Sea. The front has a collage: beachgoers under an umbrella, a pier into the sea, hotel buildings (including one marked "STEAUA MARE"), and greenery. Large title reads "EFORIE NORD." The reverse has Romanian text fields, handwritten message and address, two Romanian stamps, and a postmark from Eforie Nord.
